seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Rockville Centre 2026
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Rockville Centre, NY for 2026: the Village Green tree lighting plus nearby Lakeview and Oceanside tree lightings.
lede: Rockville Centre starts its season with a Village Green tree lighting, and neighbors in Lakeview and Oceanside hold tree lightings the same week.
celebrates: The Village of Rockville Centre holds its Christmas Tree Lighting Ceremony on Thursday, December 3, at 7 pm on the Village Green, according to the village's own website. Nearby, the Lakeview Civic Association lights its tree on Friday, December 4, and the Oceanside Chamber of Commerce lights its tree on Sunday, December 6. Because all three are free community events within a few days of each other, families can visit more than one. The village's social post calls the 2026 ceremony the 4th annual tree lighting.
lastyear: For 2025 we did not find a village recap, but the village's event page for the 2024 ceremony shows the tree lighting on Tuesday, December 3, 2024, at 7 pm, at the same Village Green location. That means the ceremony has been held on the first week of December in recent years. The village's 2026 social post describes the ceremony as its 4th annual tree lighting, which suggests the tradition dates back only a few years.
facts: The Village of Rockville Centre announces its tree lighting on its homepage and its events calendar. The Village Green is the setting for the ceremony. The ceremony has moved in recent years, with the village's 2024 listing on a Tuesday and the 2026 listing on a Thursday. Lakeview and Oceanside each hold their own neighborhood lightings in the same week.
trains: Ride the rails to the holidays. The MTA says the Long Island Rail Road's Holiday Lights Train, a locomotive covered in thousands of lights, runs along all electric branches from Monday, November 23 into January, so families who ride the LIRR this season may spot it. Check the LIRR timetable before you plan a train trip to the events on this page, and bring the children to the window to look for the glowing locomotive.

faq: How does Rockville Centre celebrate Christmas?
The Village of Rockville Centre holds a tree lighting ceremony on the Village Green, and the nearby Lakeview and Oceanside communities hold their own tree lightings in the same week.
Is the Rockville Centre tree lighting free?

The village lists the ceremony as a community event without a ticket price, and the Lakeview and Oceanside lightings are neighborhood and chamber events. Check each host before you go in case of weather changes.
When is the Rockville Centre tree lighting in 2026?
Thursday, December 3, 2026, at 7 pm on the Village Green, according to the Village of Rockville Centre.
Can we visit more than one tree lighting in Rockville Centre?
Yes. The Lakeview lighting is on December 4 and the Oceanside lighting is on December 6, so families can visit all three over four days.
